question: Do GeckoTerminal's missing 15-min bars for PumpSwap PUMP/USDC mean zero on-chain volume?
method: scripts/research/lphedge2_coverage.py: pool signatures paged back from each of the 10 train-period LP events (public RPC, 429 back-off) to cover the two previous UTC days; every successful pool tx inside a GT-missing bar fetched and counted as a swap if a pool vault token balance changed (independent of log decoding).

missing_bars_with_vault_move.what: the PUMP/USDC WithdrawEvent at 03:18:42 (liquidity event, not volume)
one successful tx moved a vault; not identified as an LP event; at most one swap missed

conclusion: 345 of 347 GT-missing bars (99.4%) have no vault-moving transaction; one of the two exceptions is a liquidity withdrawal, so at most 1 of 347 missing bars hid a swap. Every GT-present bar has successful pool txs (median 30). GeckoTerminal omits 15-min bars with no trades: a missing bar means zero volume, not a data gap. Iteration 1's >=90/96 pool-bar rule therefore discarded valid quiet days.
limits: Sample = 25 train days in May-June (11 full); April (the quietest month) not sampled because no LP event falls there. Failed txs (arb bots) are excluded by construction as they move no reserves.
